about: Renders a few options side by side, one of them chosen, with a thumb that slides to the chosen option. A press on an option checks it, and the arrow keys move the choice along the track.

closed.about: A disabled option keeps its place and its width, and the arrow keys skip it. Here the plan keeps 30 days of history.
closed.title: One option disabled

field.about: Inside a field the group takes its name from the field's label and its description from the helper text. `fitted` spreads the options across the field's width.
field.title: In a field

fitted.about: `fitted` stretches the track to the width of its container and gives every option an equal share. Without it the track is as wide as its options.
fitted.title: Fitted

iconic.about: `iconic` squares every option and hides its words visually. The words remain the radio's accessible name.
iconic.title: Icons only

icons.about: An icon renders before an option's words, one icon size smaller than the group's size.
icons.title: Icons and words

listed: Sold homes show the price they sold for.

orientation.about: `orientation="vertical"` stacks the options, and the thumb slides down the track. The up and down arrow keys move the choice.
orientation.title: Orientation

palette.about: Every palette in every look, at size `sm`. The palette fills the solid thumb, tints the outline thumb and colors the focus ring.
palette.title: Palettes

size.about: Every size from `xs` to `xl`. The track is a control's height, so a group is level with a button or an input of the same size.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: One option chosen, none chosen, invalid, read-only and disabled. A group with no value renders no thumb. A read-only group shows its value and ignores presses.
states.title: States

title: Segment group

variant.about: `surface` raises a panel-colored thumb off the muted track, `solid` fills the thumb with the palette, and `outline` draws the track's edge and tints the thumb.
variant.title: Looks
